en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a large ornate fountain in a park. The fountain has multiple tiers with classical statues: three draped female figures stand below the upper basin, while several seated or kneeling figures and putti surround the lower basin. Strong water jets arc outward in a ring. Trees and gentle hills form the background, with a church or tower visible in the distance. At the top left is printed German text identifying the location.
